_comment: The gates, drawn in code rather than from a painting. Every colour and size a portal has is here, so tuning one is an edit to this file and a reload - there is no art to re-cut and no pipeline to re-run. The three drawings in art/buildings/portal_*.png are kept but unused; the props the pipeline still cuts from them are no longer drawn by anything.

defaults._comment: Sizes are in characters, because that is what a player compares a doorway to. A character is 32 wide and 48 tall at map pixel scale, so the default gate is 64 x 144 - about a storey and a half, which is what makes it read as a way out rather than as scenery.
defaults._pulse: One slow breath on the ground glow. Three and a half seconds is slower than anything else on the map, which is what stops three gates in one hub from feeling like a strobe.
defaults._vortex: Three sprites over two spiral textures. Different arm counts and different speeds, so the layers never line up into one turning wheel; the slowest is deliberately backwards.
defaults._quantise: Alpha steps in the spiral and the glow. Six bands rather than a smooth ramp: these are drawn at map pixel scale and magnified by the camera, and a gradient that is smooth at 1x is a muddy smear at 3x.

portals.name: Meadows
portals._style: Rough blocks in warm grey, laid a little unevenly, with a crooked keystone. Vines up both jambs and small flowers where they catch the light.

portals.name: Deep Forest
portals._style: Two twisted trunks that lean together and meet overhead. Moss on the northern faces, vines hanging from the crown.

portals.name: Mystical Caves
portals._style: Shards leaning in over a dark mouth, pale blue and faceted. Glowing mushrooms at the feet, motes rising out of the dark.
portals._glowPulse: The caves pulse harder than the others. Their gate is the one that is meant to look like it is doing something.

portals.name: The Village
portals._style: The way home, in every biome. The same rough arch as the Meadows gate so that a player leaving anywhere recognises it, in the brand green rather than a biome colour.
